meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Every liquidity operation of the RBI each day since November 2012: repo and reverse repo (fixed and variable rate), SDF, MSF, long-term and targeted repos, special facilities, and outright open market purchases and sales
meta.note: RBI, Liquidity Operations by RBI (Weekly Statistical Supplement table, DBIE report 8; also reports 21 and 702). Amounts in ₹ crore, converted from rupees. Each operation is printed as a positive amount; the RBI's table marks injection and absorption by the kind of operation, not by sign.
